title: Pure Clown Crew
summary: Pure Clown Crew build with generic hand traps, staples, and an automatic Extra Deck. Clown Crew Spells and Traps cheat Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Clown Crew monsters straight out of the Deck or Extra Deck ignoring their summoning conditions, and Clown Crew Biancaviso Tributes them to trigger their Tribute payoffs.

summary.title: Starters
points: Clown Crew Cappello is a one-card Pendulum starter: from the Pendulum Scale it mills a Clown Crew card to Special Summon itself, and when Tributed it summons a Clown Crew monster from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Clown Crew Flair (Ritual) reveals itself in the hand to search any Clown Crew card, then flips a monster face-down or clears Rituals when Tributed.
Clown Crew Rehearsal Tributes a monster from the hand or field to search both Clown Crew Biancaviso and a Clown Crew Spell or Trap, and banishes from the GY to Ritual Summon Flair.

summary.title: Opening: Clown Crew Cappello
steps: Place Clown Crew Cappello in the Pendulum Zone and use its Scale effect to mill a Clown Crew Spell or Trap (such as Rehearsal or Soiree Operations) and Special Summon itself.

Activate Clown Crew Rehearsal (or Tribute Cappello via a Clown Crew effect) to add Clown Crew Biancaviso and Clown Crew Malabarisme, triggering Cappello to cheat out an Extra Deck Clown Crew (such as Meteor or Diabolo).
Set Malabarisme to summon two more Clown Crew types from the Deck or Extra Deck and Tribute Summon Biancaviso on either turn.

summary.title: Tribute Payoffs & Lock
points: Most Clown Crew effects that cheat monsters out of the Deck or Extra Deck stop you from activating the effects of monsters Special Summoned from the Deck or Extra Deck until the end of the next turn, so those monsters exist to supply passive continuous buffs and to be Tributed.
Clown Crew Meteor (Synchro) makes your Tribute Summons unrespondable on the field and recovers a Clown Crew card when Tributed.
Clown Crew Diabolo (Fusion) grants double piercing damage to Tribute Summoned monsters and Sets a Clown Crew Trap when Tributed.

Clown Crew Fiends (Rank 3 Xyz) boosts Tribute Summoned monsters by 1000 ATK and Sets a Clown Crew Spell when Tributed, while Clown Crew Dristy (Link-2) grants double attacks and resets both players' hands when Tributed.

summary.title: Control: Clown Crew Biancaviso
summary.text: Biancaviso is Tribute Summoned using Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum, or Link monsters, drawing cards or negating cards up to the number of different monster card types Tributed, and can trigger a Tribute Summon during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Clown Crew Malabarisme summons two Clown Crew monsters from the Deck or Extra Deck as a Quick-Play, and Tributes a monster from the GY to bounce a card.

Clown Crew Matinee Operatics summons a Clown Crew each turn and draws for every card type Tributed, while Soiree Operations summons two Clown Crews or searches one and performs a Tribute Summon from the GY.
Clown Crew Finale discards to destroy face-up cards and Tributes from the GY to search a monster; Clown Crew New Face destroys Spells/Traps per Tribute and recycles 3 Clown Crew cards to draw 1.
